Rounded M+ 1m for ARIB - license and provenance
================================================

Bundled file: rounded-mplus-1m-arib.ttf
Version reported by the font: 1.3
SHA-256: 417D40CEA344A42A422AF35AF9460891456FB794D9F7BBAFE632549C4457EBDA

Exact binary source verified on 2026-07-27:
https://github.com/5ym/arib-font/blob/main/rounded-mplus-1m-arib.ttf

Build description and original license notice:
https://github.com/5ym/arib-font/blob/main/Readme.txt

This font combines:

1. Jikasei Rounded M+ 1m regular
   License source: http://jikasei.me/font/rounded-mplus/license.html

   These fonts are free software.
   Unlimited permission is granted to use, copy, and distribute them, with
   or without modification, either commercially or noncommercially.
   THESE FONTS ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY.

2. WadaLabMaruGo2004ARIB glyphs by Kidoruigenso Rareearth
   Current upstream: https://github.com/jis2004/wlmaru

   The Rounded M+ 1m for ARIB build notice states:

   This font is a free font.
   It may be used free of charge.
   It may be used commercially or non-commercially.
   It may be redistributed and modified.
   It may be distributed installed in an operating system or attached to or
   incorporated into other software, commercially or non-commercially.
   Attribution in works created using the font is not required.
   The font terms do not extend to works created using the font.
   Permission from the font author is not required for use or redistribution.

   The current WadaLab upstream publishes the font as public domain under the
   Unlicense. Its canonical license text is available at:
   https://github.com/jis2004/wlmaru/blob/main/LICENSE

The notices above are retained for provenance even though neither grant
requires attribution. This file must accompany the font in redistributed
ResubWinny source archives, application bundles, and installers.
